body_json.answer: The corpus contains essentially no narrative about aliens controlling the government. The only alien-related post claims that "There is advanced alien technology buried in Antarctica" [T4-006363](#T4-006363), which concerns hidden technology rather than governmental control. Other posts describe the government as manipulated or controlled by non-alien actors — e.g., the Obama administration being "completelly dependent & manipulated by someone else" [T4-005979](#T4-005979) — while separate posts frame the government as tyrannical, criminal, or worthy of overthrow [T4-004698](#T4-004698) [T4-004400](#T4-004400) [T4-002351](#T4-002351). No post links aliens to government control.
